report: Pathologist favors Jessner lymphocytic infiltration (T-cell cutaneous pseudolymphoma). Chronic facial erythematous papules/plaques, dense perivascular/periadnexal CD4+ T-cell infiltrate, CD20/CD43/CD68/CD1a positivity, low Ki-67, and absent TCR clonality support reactive T-cell pseudolymphoma. No granulomas; negative PAS/AFB/CD123/CD56/GB refute granulomatous disease, infection, and malignancy. Rosacea/lupus tumidus are less likely; DIF/ANA pending. Best Dx: Jessner lymphocytic infiltration.
